manifest.description: Connect Paperclip to ACN Org Harness: issues → Org work, identity/fencing via subnet, optional legacy Task mirror inbound.
manifest.author: acnlabs

acnBaseUrl.title: ACN Base URL
acnBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the ACN instance (no trailing slash). Defaults to ACN Labs' hosted production ACN — point at your own deployment to self-host.

paperclipBaseUrl.title: Paperclip Base URL
paperclipBaseUrl.description: Public base URL of this Paperclip instance (e.g. https://app.paperclip.ai). Used to construct the ACN harness webhook URL.

acnApiKeyRef.title: ACN API Key (secret ref)
acnApiKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the ACN agent API key used to call ACN on behalf of Paperclip.

acnHarnessSecretRef.title: ACN Harness Webhook Secret (secret ref)
acnHarnessSecretRef.description: Secret reference to the shared HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign and verify ACN harness webhook deliveries (X-ACN-Signature). Leave blank to skip verification (NOT recommended in production).

acnOrgId.title: ACN Org ID
acnOrgId.description: Existing Org Harness org_id (org_…). If empty, the plugin creates one bound to ACN Subnet ID on first setup and stores it in plugin state.

acnSubnetId.title: ACN Subnet ID
acnSubnetId.description: Fence subnet for harness webhooks. Required when ACN Org ID is empty (used to create/bind the Org). Prefer the Org's fence subnet.

autoCreateIssues.title: Auto-create Paperclip issues for inbound Org work
autoCreateIssues.description: When true, external org.work_created webhooks create a Paperclip Issue. Does not control Task Pool mirroring.

enableLegacyTaskMirror.title: Enable legacy Task Pool → Issue mirror
enableLegacyTaskMirror.description: Opt-in: task.created creates Issues and startup syncs open Task Pool tasks. Prefer Org org.* inbound. Already-mapped Task Issues still receive lifecycle updates when off.

autoApproveOnDone.title: Sync 'done' to ACN when Paperclip issue completes
autoApproveOnDone.description: When true: Org-mapped issues PATCH work status to done; legacy Task-mirrored issues call /review approve. Cancelled always syncs.

webhooks.description: Receives HMAC-signed lifecycle events from ACN (org.work_* / org.loop_tick preferred; task.* legacy).
